IMA_BUILD_RULES.rule1: Every new component enters through governance registry
IMA_BUILD_RULES.rule2: Every working component is locked after verification
IMA_BUILD_RULES.rule3: No modification of locked component without new version
IMA_BUILD_RULES.rule5: No damage to existing working components
IMA_BUILD_RULES.rule6: Graveyard components may be restored only after verification
